--[[
    Community Accessory Orbit
    -------------------------
    Simple equipped-accessory orbit with the Source -30 netless-style write.

    Important:
    Source -30 helps keep locally owned accessory physics stable in experiences
    where the client retains ownership. It does not guarantee replication or
    protection in every game; the server still has final authority.

    Controls:
      RightShift  - show / hide menu
      Toggle      - orbit currently equipped accessories
]]

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

local LP = Players.LocalPlayer
if not LP then return end

local SOURCE_VELOCITY = Vector3.new(-30, 0, 0)

local ORBIT_RADIUS = 5.5
local ORBIT_HEIGHT = 1.25
local ORBIT_SPEED = 1.35
local ITEM_SPIN_SPEED = 1.8
local RESCAN_INTERVAL = 0.25

local GUI_NAME = "CommunityAccessoryOrbit"
local ENV_KEY = "__CommunityAccessoryOrbitUnload"

local env = (type(getgenv) == "function" and getgenv()) or _G
if type(env[ENV_KEY]) == "function" then
    pcall(env[ENV_KEY])
end

local playerGui = LP:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
local old = playerGui:FindFirstChild(GUI_NAME)
if old then old:Destroy() end

local alive = true
local orbitEnabled = false
local orbitClock = 0
local lastScan = 0

local records = {}
local connections = {}

local function track(c)
    connections[#connections + 1] = c
    return c
end

local function character()
    return LP.Character
end

local function rootPart()
    local char = character()
    return char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
end

local function accessoryJoints(char, accessory, handle)
    local out = {}
    if not (char and accessory and handle) then return out end

    for _, obj in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
        if obj:IsA("JointInstance") or obj:IsA("WeldConstraint") then
            local ok, p0, p1 = pcall(function()
                return obj.Part0, obj.Part1
            end)

            if ok and (p0 == handle or p1 == handle) then
                local other = (p0 == handle) and p1 or p0
                if other
                    and other:IsA("BasePart")
                    and other:IsDescendantOf(char)
                    and not other:IsDescendantOf(accessory)
                then
                    out[#out + 1] = {
                        joint = obj,
                        parent = obj.Parent,
                    }
                end
            end
        end
    end

    return out
end

local function detachRecord(record)
    local handle = record.handle
    if not (handle and handle.Parent) then return end

    for _, info in ipairs(record.joints) do
        if info.joint and info.joint.Parent then
            info.joint.Parent = nil
        end
    end

    handle.Anchored = false
    handle.CanCollide = false
    handle.CanTouch = false
    handle.CanQuery = false
    handle.Massless = true
end

local function restoreRecord(record)
    local handle = record.handle

    if handle and handle.Parent then
        pcall(function()
            handle.CanCollide = record.canCollide
            handle.CanTouch = record.canTouch
            handle.CanQuery = record.canQuery
            handle.Massless = record.massless
        end)
    end

    for _, info in ipairs(record.joints) do
        if info.joint
            and info.joint.Parent == nil
            and info.parent
            and info.parent.Parent
        then
            pcall(function()
                info.joint.Parent = info.parent
            end)
        end
    end
end

local function addAccessory(accessory)
    if records[accessory] then return records[accessory] end
    if not accessory:IsA("Accessory") then return nil end

    local handle = accessory:FindFirstChild("Handle")
    if not (handle and handle:IsA("BasePart")) then return nil end

    local char = character()
    if not char then return nil end

    local record = {
        accessory = accessory,
        handle = handle,
        joints = accessoryJoints(char, accessory, handle),

        canCollide = handle.CanCollide,
        canTouch = handle.CanTouch,
        canQuery = handle.CanQuery,
        massless = handle.Massless,
    }

    records[accessory] = record

    if orbitEnabled then
        detachRecord(record)
    end

    return record
end

local function scanAccessories()
    local char = character()
    if not char then return end

    for _, child in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
        if child:IsA("Accessory") then
            addAccessory(child)
        end
    end

    for accessory, record in pairs(records) do
        if not accessory.Parent or not accessory:IsDescendantOf(char) then
            records[accessory] = nil
        elseif record.handle and record.handle.Parent then
            -- Keep body welds from being silently recreated.
            local newJoints = accessoryJoints(char, accessory, record.handle)
            for _, info in ipairs(newJoints) do
                local known = false
                for _, oldInfo in ipairs(record.joints) do
                    if oldInfo.joint == info.joint then
                        known = true
                        break
                    end
                end
                if not known then
                    record.joints[#record.joints + 1] = info
                end
            end

            if orbitEnabled then
                detachRecord(record)
            end
        end
    end
end

local function recordList()
    local list = {}
    for _, record in pairs(records) do
        if record.handle and record.handle.Parent then
            list[#list + 1] = record
        end
    end
    table.sort(list, function(a, b)
        return a.accessory.Name < b.accessory.Name
    end)
    return list
end

local function applySource30(handle)
    if not (handle and handle.Parent) then return end

    -- Keep these AFTER every CFrame / physics operation.
    -- This is the actual "Source -30" part.
    handle.Velocity = SOURCE_VELOCITY
    handle.AssemblyLinearVelocity = SOURCE_VELOCITY
end

local function updateOrbit(dt)
    if not orbitEnabled then return end

    local root = rootPart()
    if not root then return end

    orbitClock += dt * ORBIT_SPEED

    local now = os.clock()
    if now - lastScan >= RESCAN_INTERVAL then
        lastScan = now
        scanAccessories()
    end

    local list = recordList()
    local count = #list
    if count == 0 then return end

    for index, record in ipairs(list) do
        local handle = record.handle
        if handle and handle.Parent then
            detachRecord(record)

            local angle = orbitClock + ((index - 1) / count) * math.pi * 2
            local localOffset = Vector3.new(
                math.cos(angle) * ORBIT_RADIUS,
                ORBIT_HEIGHT + math.sin(angle * 2) * 0.35,
                math.sin(angle) * ORBIT_RADIUS
            )

            local worldPosition = root.CFrame:PointToWorldSpace(localOffset)
            local spin = orbitClock * ITEM_SPIN_SPEED + index * 0.35

            handle.CFrame =
                CFrame.new(worldPosition)
                * CFrame.Angles(
                    math.sin(angle) * 0.22,
                    -angle + math.pi * 0.5,
                    spin
                )

            handle.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero

            -- FINAL velocity write.
            applySource30(handle)
        end
    end
end

local function setOrbit(on)
    orbitEnabled = on == true

    if orbitEnabled then
        orbitClock = 0
        lastScan = 0
        scanAccessories()

        for _, record in pairs(records) do
            detachRecord(record)
            applySource30(record.handle)
        end
    else
        for _, record in pairs(records) do
            restoreRecord(record)
        end
    end
end

unload = function()
    if not alive then return end
    alive = false

    end

    if gui and gui.Parent then

    end

    if env[ENV_KEY] == unload then
        env[ENV_KEY] = nil
    end
end

env[ENV_KEY] = unload

refreshUi()
scripts.features:
A lightweight community accessory orbit built around the Source -30 method.

Equipped accessories are detached and driven in a live orbit around your character while the script continuously watches for newly equipped accessories and recreated body welds. Source Vector3.new(-30, 0, 0) is kept as the final velocity write each Heartbeat to help keep accessory physics stable when the client retains network ownership.

The goal of this release is to expose the Source -30 technique in a small, readable script instead of hiding it inside a massive hub.
Includes a compact draggable menu with orbit controls, radius adjustment, speed adjustment, automatic accessory rescanning, weld guarding, collision/touch disabling, respawn handling, and clean unload/re-execution support.
Replication and physics behavior are experience-dependent; the server still has final authority.
Features
- Source -30 accessory physics method
- Live accessory orbit
- Automatic equipped-accessory detection
- Continuously rescans for new accessories
- Detects and detaches recreated accessory welds
- Collision disabled while orbiting
- Touch disabled while orbiting
- Source -30 applied as the final Heartbeat velocity write
- Adjustable orbit radius
- Adjustable orbit speed
- Individual accessory spinning
- Orbit bobbing/motion
- Supports multiple equipped accessories automatically
- Restores accessory joints when orbit is disabled
- Respawn handling
- Draggable compact GUI
- Right Shift menu hide/show
- Safe re-execution/unload handling
- No loadstrings
- Standalone script
- Clean community-oriented source
- Open source / easy to modify

local Players = game:GetService("Players")

--// SETTINGS

local farming = false

local frameCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")

frameCorner.Parent = frame

-- Sky blue -> dark blue
local gradient = Instance.new("UIGradient")
gradient.Color = ColorSequence.new({
	ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromRGB(100, 210, 255)),
	ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(20, 50, 140))
})
gradient.Rotation = 90
gradient.Parent = frame

--// TITLE
local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
title.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(170, 25)

title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
title.Text = "PineTree Shop"

title.TextSize = 17
title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
title.Parent = frame

--// AMOUNT BOX
local amount = Instance.new("TextBox")
amount.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(170, 34)
amount.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(15, 35)
amount.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(235, 250, 255)

cost.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(15, 70)
cost.BackgroundTransparency = 1
cost.Text = "80 gold"
cost.TextSize = 15
cost.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
cost.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 235, 90)
cost.Parent = frame

--// BUY BUTTON

buy.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(15, 96)
buy.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 100, 200)
buy.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)

buy.BorderSizePixel = 0
buy.Parent = frame

local buyCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
buyCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 9)
buyCorner.Parent = buy

--// AUTOFARM BUTTON
local farmToggle = Instance.new("TextButton")
farmToggle.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(170, 35)
farmToggle.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(15, 140)
farmToggle.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(35, 75, 145)
farmToggle.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
farmToggle.Text = "AutoFarm: OFF"
farmToggle.TextSize = 15
farmToggle.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
farmToggle.BorderSizePixel = 0
farmToggle.Parent = frame

local farmCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
farmCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 9)
farmCorner.Parent = farmToggle

--// COST CALCULATOR
local function updateCost()
	local quantity = tonumber(amount.Text)

	if quantity and quantity > 0 then
		quantity = math.floor(quantity)
		cost.Text = (quantity * PINE_PRICE) .. " gold"
	else
		cost.Text = "0 gold"
	end
end

amount:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(updateCost)

--// BUY PINE TREES
buy.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	local quantity = tonumber(amount.Text)

	if quantity and quantity > 0 then
		quantity = math.floor(quantity)
		Event:InvokeServer("PineTree", quantity)
	end
end)

--// AUTOFARM
local function startFarm()
	task.spawn(function()
		while farming do
			local character = player.Character
			local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

			if not root then
				task.wait(1)
				continue
			end

			for _, pointData in ipairs(points) do
				if not farming then
					break
				end

				local position = pointData[1]
				local duration = pointData[2]

				root.CFrame = CFrame.new(position)

				local bodyVelocity = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
				bodyVelocity.MaxForce = Vector3.new(
					math.huge,
					math.huge,
					math.huge
				)
				bodyVelocity.Velocity = Vector3.zero
				bodyVelocity.Parent = root

				local startTime = os.clock()

				while farming and os.clock() - startTime < duration do
					root.CFrame = CFrame.new(position)
					task.wait()
				end

				bodyVelocity:Destroy()
			end

			if farming then
				task.wait(WAIT_AFTER_ROUTE)
			end
		end
	end)
end

--// AUTOFARM TOGGLE
farmToggle.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	farming = not farming

	if farming then
		farmToggle.Text = "AutoFarm: ON"
		farmToggle.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 150, 90)
		startFarm()
	else
		farmToggle.Text = "AutoFarm: OFF"
		farmToggle.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(35, 75, 145)
	end
end)

--// DRAG MAIN GUI
local dragging = false
local dragStart
local startPosition

frame.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
		or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

		dragging = true
		dragStart = input.Position
		startPosition = frame.Position

		input.Changed:Connect(function()
			if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
				dragging = false
			end
		end)
	end
end)

UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
	if dragging and (
		input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
		or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
	) then

		local delta = input.Position - dragStart

		frame.Position = UDim2.new(
			startPosition.X.Scale,
			startPosition.X.Offset + delta.X,
			startPosition.Y.Scale,
			startPosition.Y.Offset + delta.Y
		)
	end
end)

--// SHOW/HIDE TOGGLE

toggle.Parent = gui

local toggleCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")

toggleCorner.Parent = toggle

toggle.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	frame.Visible = not frame.Visible
end)

--// DRAG TOGGLE
local toggleDragging = false
local toggleDragStart
local toggleStartPosition

toggle.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
		or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

		toggleDragging = true
		toggleDragStart = input.Position
		toggleStartPosition = toggle.Position

		input.Changed:Connect(function()
			if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
				toggleDragging = false
			end
		end)
	end
end)

UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
	if toggleDragging and (
		input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
		or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
	) then

		local delta = input.Position - toggleDragStart

			toggleStartPosition.X.Offset + delta.X,
			toggleStartPosition.Y.Scale,
			toggleStartPosition.Y.Offset + delta.Y

end)

local function makeDraggable(guiObject)
    local dragging = false
    local dragInput
    local dragStart
    local startPosition

    local function updatePosition(input)
        local delta = input.Position - dragStart
        guiObject.Position = UDim2.new(
            startPosition.X.Scale,
            startPosition.X.Offset + delta.X,
            startPosition.Y.Scale,
            startPosition.Y.Offset + delta.Y
        )
    end

    guiObject.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
            or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
        then
            dragging = true
            dragStart = input.Position
            startPosition = guiObject.Position

            input.Changed:Connect(function()
                if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
                    dragging = false
                end
            end)
        end
    end)

    guiObject.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        -- The payload checks MouseButton1 here rather than MouseMovement.
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
            or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
        then
            dragInput = input
        end
    end)

    UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if input == dragInput and dragging then
            updatePosition(input)
        end
    end)
end

    tpSpeed = math.floor(1 + relativePosition * 299)
    speedHandle.Position = UDim2.new(relativePosition, 0, -0.5, 0)
    speedLabel.Text = "TP Speed: " .. tpSpeed .. " Studs/s"
end

local draggingSpeed = false

speedHandle.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
        or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
    then
        draggingSpeed = true
    end
end)

UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
        or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
    then
        draggingSpeed = false
    end
end)

UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if draggingSpeed
        and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
            or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch)
    then
        updateSpeed(input)
    end
end)

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(deltaTime)
    if not tpWalkEnabled then
        return
    end

    local character = localPlayer.Character
    if not character then
        return
    end

    local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local rootPart = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

    if humanoid and rootPart and humanoid.MoveDirection.Magnitude > 0 then
        rootPart.CFrame = rootPart.CFrame + humanoid.MoveDirection * tpSpeed * deltaTime
    end
end)
